description: This file contains Go source code implementing variable expansion and replacement functions for the Kubernetes kustomize project, specifically in the refvar package.

methods.name: syntaxWrap
methods.description: Wraps an input string with variable expansion syntax using '$' and parentheses.

methods.name: MakePrimitiveReplacer
methods.description: Creates a function that replaces variables with primitive values from a map, counting hits and handling non-primitive types.

methods.name: DoReplacements
methods.description: Performs variable substitution in an input string using a provided mapping function.

methods.name: tryReadVariableName
methods.description: Parses a variable name from the input string, identifying whether it is a valid variable expression.
